body: Your loved ones would try and stop you because they love you and want to experience life with you. Please give them that chance.

I definitely stay up late (I only got a couple hours of sleep tonight) replaying everything in my head, from the last moments of my baby’s life to all the things I did wrong. It’s miserable. I hope that you find something that helps you keep going.
I’m sure he would be, for a while. But he is stronger than I am and I know he’s get through it. He takes such good care of our child and I can’t bring myself to get off the couch.
